slides.texte_overlay:
How 99% of men lose
their AURA

They complain out loud.
Every problem announced.
Fix it. Don't narrate it.

They live on their phone.
Head down in every room.
Presence starts
when you look up.

They break small promises.
"I'll call you." They don't.
Small misses kill
big respect.

They gossip.
What you say about others
tells people what you'll
say about them.

They lose their temper.
Raise your voice,
lose the room.
Calm is the real flex.

They stop learning.
Same opinions for 10 years.
A curious man
never goes dull.
